text:
A transparent, accessible platform for discovering causes,
making donations, and managing community impact.

Sources: Donation_Management_System.pptx cover details; docs/Goodwill_Donation_Management_System_Final_Report.pdf. Project content is adapted for Goodwill Foundation; reference deck contributes section-heading structure only.
A role-based web application that connects donors with active community campaigns.
Make it easier to discover causes, give securely through a simulated checkout, and keep a clear record of each successful gift.
Guests explore campaigns. Donors manage gifts and receipts. Administrators manage campaigns and review platform activity.
React and Vite client, Express API, and a Prisma-backed PostgreSQL mode, with a JSON demo mode for local showcase.
One experience from campaign discovery to verified receipt.

Sources: docs/Goodwill_Donation_Management_System_Final_Report.pdf; docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN_DOCUMENTATION.md. Project content is adapted for Goodwill Foundation; reference deck contributes section-heading structure only.
Donation processes can feel fragmented when discovery, payment records, and follow-up live in separate places.
Donors need clear campaign details and categories before choosing a cause.
Without organized records, donors may struggle to confirm what happened to a donation.
Campaign updates, receipt handling, and reporting can take time when managed by hand.
Sensitive donor information needs controlled access and a reliable audit trail.
Sources: docs/Goodwill_Donation_Management_System_Final_Report.pdf. Project content is adapted for Goodwill Foundation; reference deck contributes section-heading structure only.
A single portal supports campaign discovery, giving, and ongoing administration.
Successful gifts create a receipt and history entry.
Donors and administrators use role-specific workspaces.
The payment provider is a local simulator; live card processing is not configured.

Sources: docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN_DOCUMENTATION.md; docs/Goodwill_Donation_Management_System_Final_Report.pdf. Project content is adapted for Goodwill Foundation; reference deck contributes section-heading structure only.
Core features are organized around donor confidence and efficient campaign operations.
Category browsing, search, campaign detail pages
Donation history, receipts, saved causes, preferences
Campaign management, activity overview, donor support
Payment attempts, success-only receipts, transaction references
Dashboard summaries plus CSV and PDF outputs
Role checks, validation, rate limits, audit and security history

Sources: docs/Goodwill_Donation_Management_System_Final_Report.pdf; docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md. Project content is adapted for Goodwill Foundation; reference deck contributes section-heading structure only.
Donation reporting keeps the donor’s personal record separate from organization-wide oversight.

• Donation history and status
• Printable receipt for successful gifts
• Receipt and transaction references
• Downloadable personal history

• Campaign and donation summaries
• CSV exports for operational review
• PDF reports and printable views
• Audit context for key actions
A receipt is issued only after a successful simulated payment outcome.
Sources: docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md; docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN_DOCUMENTATION.md. Project content is adapted for Goodwill Foundation; reference deck contributes section-heading structure only.
Access is separated by role so each person sees the right tools and records.
Explore campaigns and begin a donation without opening a donor account.
Manage profile and preferences; review own donation history, receipts, and support requests.
Create and update campaigns; review platform activity, reports, and support operations.

Failure path: retain the failed payment attempt, show the outcome, and do not create a receipt.
